items.statement_scope: Whole original Problem C1, counted once: formulate two-way RM/GEQ reductions without asymptotic error-rate loss, stating standard and additional assumptions. Author answer is affirmative under Sections 1-2 oracle model: compact bounded convex RM set, convex Lipschitz differentiable losses; bounded restorative GEQ vector fields with common finite radius; increasing sublinear error functions. Theorems 6-7 give both directions, with constants allowed to depend on the problem.
